lines.en: I skim through a magazine about architects and architect related stuff and find that the issue is focusing on large buildings in particular.
lines.zh: 我翻着一本讲建筑师和相关内容的杂志，发现这期特别聚焦大型建筑。

lines.en: It goes over the mechanics and construction of them and even features images of gigantic skyscrapers with holes in the middle of them to help prevent the buildings from swaying in the wind.
lines.zh: 它讲解了它们的机械原理和建造方式，甚至还配了摩天大楼的图片——楼身中间开着洞，用来防止建筑在风中摇摆。

lines.en: I am once again fascinated by the innovations in modern construction and- oh? What is this?!

lines.en: It looks like the magazine is holding a sweepstakes where readers can submit their answers for a chance to win a piece of a small key to my bedroom!

lines.en: I can't imagine many people will enter this sweepstakes, so I'm pretty much guaranteed to win so long as I can answer the question.

lines.en: I open up a book about Jesus Christ and all of his buddies and prepare myself to hear about their crazy antics out on the road.
lines.zh: 我打开一本讲耶稣基督和他那帮伙伴的书，准备好听他们在路上干的那些疯狂勾当。

lines.en: The book tells a brief story about a ragtag band of bearded dudes riding around on camels and kissing each other all the time.
lines.zh: 这本书讲了一小段故事：一群衣衫褴褛、满脸胡子的人骑着骆驼到处跑，还整天互相亲吻。

lines.en: I am very glad to hear that they were so open about their sexuality and understand now why roughly half of the girls in my class are bisexual.
lines.zh: 我很高兴得知他们对性取向如此坦诚，也终于明白为什么我班上差不多一半的女孩都是双性恋。

lines.en: If Jesus can fuck people of the same sex, everyone should be allowed to without being persecuted.
lines.zh: 既然耶稣都能跟同性上床，那每个人都应该被允许这么做，而不该被迫害。

lines.en: Eventually, Jesus and his friends take a break from their traveling miracle circus for a day or two to play a rousing pickup game of baseball against a group of gentiles.
lines.zh: 后来，耶稣和他的朋友们从巡回行奇迹的马戏团里抽出一两天休息，跟一群外邦人来了一场激烈的临时棒球赛。

lines.en: In stark contradiction to the words he preaches, Jesus goes unto them and says the following:
lines.zh: 与他宣扬的教义形成鲜明矛盾的是，耶稣走到他们面前，说了下面这句话：
{i}准备被操吧，外邦人。{/i}

lines.en: Jesus is a lot cooler than I remember, especially because he is wearing sunglasses in all of the illustrations in this book.
lines.zh: 耶稣比我记忆中酷多了，尤其是因为书里所有插画中他都戴着墨镜。

lines.en: The rest of the story is basically about Jesus and the apostles creaming a bunch of unprepared children in an athletic contest and I turn to the final page feeling motivated and gleeful.
lines.zh: 故事剩下的部分基本上就是耶稣和门徒在一场体育比赛里把一群毫无准备的小孩子打得落花流水，我翻到最后一页时，心里既受鼓舞又欢欣雀跃。

lines.en: I open up a medical magazine advertising different types of breathing exercises on the cover.

lines.en: Since I'm going to be trapped in this room for probably the rest of forever, I figure it will be nice to learn some to help calm me down when I need it.
lines.zh: 既然我大概要被永远困在这个房间里了，我想学点呼吸法，好在需要的时候让自己平静下来，应该不错。

lines.en: Unfortunately, it looks like most of the pages are written in a different language.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，大部分页面似乎都是用别的语言写的。

lines.en: There is one section I can find in Japanese, but it must not be very {i}good{/i} Japanese since I'm not really sure what it's asking.
lines.zh: 有一节我能找到日语的，但那日语肯定不太{i}地道{/i}，因为我实在搞不懂它在问什么。
那篇文章是这么写的：

lines.en: {i}To breathe! What is why you would do that? And how?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}呼吸！你为什么要这么做？又该怎么呼吸？{/i}

lines.en: {i}The answer is simple. It is because you can. And because you will.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}答案很简单。因为你能。也因为你会。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Follow this simple breath pattern and all will become easy. All will become good.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}照着这个简单的呼吸节奏做，一切都会变得容易。一切都会变好。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Your troubles, no more! Your breath, yes! How to do!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你的烦恼，不再有！你的呼吸，有！怎么做！{/i}

lines.en: {i}God is real! God is good! He breathe!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}上帝是真的！上帝是善的！他呼吸！{/i}

lines.en: From out of the book crawls a worm that finds its way onto my hand.

lines.en: I don't know how long it's been inside, nor how it survived being pressed between the pages, but I take it as a sign that I must proceed.
lines.zh: 我不知道它在里面待了多久，也不知道它是怎么在被压在书页之间活下来的，但我把它当作一个信号：我必须继续。

lines.en: There's nothing written inside, but I somehow understand everything the book has to say.

lines.en: I feel the words being injected into my veins each time my skin makes contact with the half-rotted, stale paper holding everything together.

lines.en: I focus all of my energy on attempting to locate all of the squids I ate earlier since they're probably not digested yet.
lines.zh: 我把全部精力集中在寻找之前吃下去的那些鱿鱼上，因为它们大概还没消化。

lines.en: After a bit of intestinal navigation, I uncover them and begin to clench my gut in order to squeeze all of the ink out.
lines.zh: 经过一番肠道导航，我找到了它们，开始收紧肚子，把所有墨水都挤出来。

lines.en: It bubbles up from my GI tract and works its way through my esophagus.
lines.zh: 它从我的胃肠道里冒出气泡，一路穿过食道。

lines.en: I open up my mouth and let some of it dribble onto the sweepstakes page.

lines.en: In Solitaire, there are 4 types of piles: The Tableau, The Stock, The Talon, and The Foundations.
lines.zh: 在纸牌里，有 4 种牌堆：牌面区（The Tableau）、牌库（The Stock）、待用堆（The Talon）和基础堆（The Foundations）。

lines.en: The Tableau consist of 7 piles. The first pile has 1 card. The second pile has 2 cards. The third pile has 3 cards and so on until there are 7 piles. Only the top card in each pile is faced up.
lines.zh: 牌面区由 7 叠牌组成。第一叠 1 张，第二叠 2 张，第三叠 3 张，以此类推，直到共 7 叠。每叠只有最上面的一张正面朝上。

lines.en: The remaining cards after building the Tableau are called the Stock.
lines.zh: 摆好牌面区之后剩下的牌叫牌库。

lines.en: The Talon is a pile of 3 cards from the Stock. In the Talon, only the top card is faced up.
lines.zh: 待用堆是从牌库里取出的 3 张牌。在待用堆里，只有最上面一张正面朝上。

lines.en: The Foundations consist of 4 stacks of cards (one for each suit) in ascending order (Ace to King). At the beginning of the game, The Foundations is empty.
lines.zh: 基础堆由 4 叠牌组成（每种花色一叠），按升序排列（从 A 到 K）。游戏开始时，基础堆是空的。

lines.en: Within the Tableau, faced up cards are transferred in descending order (King to Ace) and in alternating color.
lines.zh: 在牌面区内，正面朝上的牌按降序（从 K 到 A）、且颜色交替的方式转移。

lines.en: The player may transfer the top card or stack of faced up cards to any of the piles in an attempt to create the sequence of descending value and alternating color.
lines.zh: 玩家可以转移最上面的一张牌、或一叠正面朝上的牌到任意一叠，以尝试形成点数递减、颜色交替的序列。

lines.en: An empty spot in the Tableau may be filled with a king.  If the player cannot move any cards within the Tableau, 3 cards are selected from the top of the Stock pile to form the Talon.
lines.zh: 牌面区的空位可以用国王填上。如果玩家在牌面区里无法移动任何牌，就从牌库顶部取 3 张牌组成待用堆。

lines.en: If the first card in the Talon cannot be played, 3 more cards are selected from the Stock.
lines.zh: 如果待用堆的第一张牌不能出，就再从牌库取 3 张。

lines.en: When and if the Stock runs out, the Talon is reshuffled to form a new Stock and the process continues.
lines.zh: 如果牌库用完了，待用堆会被重新洗回牌库，如此继续。

lines.en: While the player is sequencing the Tableau, the player is also trying to build up the Foundations stacks.
lines.zh: 玩家在排列牌面区的同时，也在努力搭建基础堆。

lines.en: The top card from the Talon or the Tableau stacks may be transferred to the Foundations.
lines.zh: 待用堆或牌面区各叠最上面的牌可以转移到基础堆。

lines.en: When all cards have been transferred in ascending order (Ace to King) to the Foundations, the game is won.
lines.zh: 当所有牌都按升序（从 A 到 K）转移到基础堆时，游戏就赢了。

lines.en: If no more moves can be made and the Foundations is incomplete, the game is lost.
lines.zh: 如果再也无法移动，而基础堆还没填满，游戏就输了。

lines.zh: 但接着我想起她从没学会骑自行车，意识到那不可能。
可怜的 Maya。

lines.en: I will have to teach her one day.
lines.zh: 总有一天我得教她。

lines.en: I watch TV for so long that the day ends.
lines.zh: 我看电视看得太久，一天就这么结束了。
: 晚安，世界。
: Zzz……
: 新的一天开始了！

lines.en: What do I want to do?
lines.zh: 我想做什么？

lines.en: I call up all my friends and throw a dance party since I am not allowed to go outside.
lines.zh: 我给所有朋友打电话，办了一场舞会，因为我不许出门。

lines.en: Everybody shows up and we all have a good time listening to 11c.mp3, which is really just 10c.mp3 but with an extra 1.
lines.zh: 大家都来了，我们听着 11c.mp3 玩得很开心——那其实就是 10c.mp3，只是多了一个 1。

lines.en: I haven't had this much fun in a long time and I think I am going to try and do this more often.
lines.zh: 我很久没这么开心过了，我想我以后要多办几次。

lines.en: Even though we are all specialized in different styles of dance, we don't seem to mind.
lines.zh: 虽然我们各自擅长的舞种不同，但我们似乎并不在意。

lines.en: It's kind of like how everyone in my life is very good at something different from someone else- and how they all manage to blend together into one cohesive substance! Like glue!
lines.zh: 这有点像我生命中的每个人，都擅长某件别人不擅长的事——而他们又能融合成一种有凝聚力的物质！就像胶水一样！
我喜欢胶水。

lines.en: If I had glue, I could pour it all over the floor and make it so we can dance {i}forever{/i}.
lines.zh: 如果我有胶水，我就能把它倒满地板，这样我们就能{i}永远{/i}跳下去了。

lines.en: We dance for so long and then have a big slumber party, but everyone is gone by the time I wake up.
lines.zh: 我们跳了很久，然后开了个大型睡衣派对，可等我醒来时，大家都走了。
: 新的一天开始了！

lines.en: What do I want to do?
lines.zh: 我想做什么？
: 你好，朋友。

lines.en: : Hi, Sensei. Are you enjoying the spiritual successor to the popular Lessons in Love event, {i}There is Nothing?{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗨，Sensei。你还喜欢《Lessons in Love》那场人气事件《{i}什么都没有{/i}》的精神续作吗？

lines.en: : No. There are too many questions this time and my memory is bad.
lines.zh: : 不喜欢。这次问题太多了，而我记性又差。

lines.en: : Can you give me a hint, please?
lines.zh: : 能给我个提示吗，拜托？

lines.en: : I would if I could, but I still haven't figured out the word of the day.
lines.zh: : 我倒是想给，可我还没弄明白今天的关键词。

lines.en: : I don't even know why puzzles have to exist in this stupid game. I should be able to experience the story however I want because I am important and special and art is only good when I say so.
lines.zh: : 我甚至不明白这破游戏为什么非要有谜题。我应该能想怎么体验故事就怎么体验，因为我很重要、很特别，而艺术只有我说好才算好。

lines.en: : Hang in there, friend! I'm sure it will all be worth it one day.
lines.zh: : 撑住啊，朋友！我相信有一天一切都会值得的。

lines.en: : Thank you, Manny. You are so nice and I am really sad that you will be gone after I escape this room.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Manny。你人真好，而我真的很伤心，等我逃出这个房间后你就不在了。

lines.en: : I'll always exist in replays, Sensei. Whenever you want to see me, I'll be right here- waiting for daylight to come so I can soak up sick UVB rays and grow even larger.
lines.zh: : 我会永远存在于回放里，Sensei。无论何时你想见我，我就在这儿——等着白昼降临，好吸收超棒的 UVB 射线，长得更大。

lines.en: : Are you ever going to turn into a fly, Manny?
lines.zh: : Manny，你有一天会变成苍蝇吗？
: 大概不会。不过没关系！

lines.en: : Sometimes, things are most beautiful before reaching their full potential.
lines.zh: : 有时候，事物在抵达完全体之前才是最美的。

lines.en: : But you fuck high-schoolers so I probably don't need to tell you that.
lines.zh: : 可你操高中生，所以这话大概不用我告诉你。
: Manny，拜托。

lines.en: : Sorry, sorry. I just don't get many opportunities to tell jokes anymore, so I had to jump on that one.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，抱歉。我只是没什么机会讲笑话了，所以这个梗我必须抓住。

lines.en: : You mean like {i}how I jump on high-schoolers?{/i} Huh? Huh???
lines.zh: : 你是说就像我{i}抓住高中生{/i}那样？哈？哈？？？

lines.en: : How come I didn't get a laugh track?
lines.zh: : 我怎么没得到笑声罐头？

lines.en: : It's just kind of sad when you say it.
lines.zh: : 你说出来就只是有点可悲。

lines.en: : This whole game is sad. Excuse me for trying to lighten the mood a little.
lines.zh: : 这整个游戏都很可悲。抱歉我想活跃一下气氛而已。

lines.en: : But anyway, I guess I'll get back to trying to remember stuff or...waiting for someone to make a mod since visual novels are too hard for me and I require outside assistance.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我想我还是回去继续试着回忆吧……或者等着有人做个 mod，毕竟视觉小说对我来说太难了，我需要外援。

lines.en: : Why are you even playing, then?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么还要玩？

lines.en: : Because I've jerked off normally too many times and need a challenge in order to cum at this point.
lines.zh: : 因为我正常打飞机太多次了，现在需要点挑战才能射出来。

lines.en: : Only a slight challenge, though. If it's any more challenging than I want it to be, it's stupid. But I'm going to keep playing anyway because that is a decision that makes sense.
lines.zh: : 只是稍微有点挑战就行。要是比我想要的程度更难，那就太蠢了。不过我还是会继续玩下去，因为这是个说得通的决定。

lines.en: : Well, I hope you have fun!
lines.zh: : 好吧，祝你玩得开心！

lines.en: : I'll be here if you want to repeat this same exact conversation again. It might help keep you entertained if you start going crazy!
lines.zh: : 如果你想把这段一模一样的对话再重复一遍，我随时都在。要是你开始发疯，它可能还能帮你解解闷！

lines.en: : Thanks, Manny! I'll see you later!
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Manny！回头见！

lines.en: I leave Manny by the window to soak in the non-existent sunlight and get back to trying to solve the stupid reset puzzle.
lines.zh: 我把 Manny 留在窗边吸收那并不存在的阳光，回去继续解那个愚蠢的重置谜题。
: 现在做什么？

lines.en: I make my way over to a phone booth that appeared in the corner of my room while I wasn't looking.
lines.zh: 我走到一间不知何时出现在我房间角落的电话亭前。

lines.en: Time to press some buttons and hope something happens.
lines.zh: 是时候按几个按钮，指望能有点动静了。

lines.en: : Thank you for calling Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: : 感谢致电 Tojo Ramen。
没人应答。
这电话显然是坏的。
试试另一个号码
: 你好？
没人应答。
这电话显然是坏的。
放弃
我该改做什么？

lines.en: : Tsuneyo? What are you still doing sentient?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo？你怎么还有意识？

lines.en: : Answering the telephone. Thank you for calling Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: : 在接电话。感谢致电 Tojo Ramen。

lines.en: : Will you be placing an order to pick up? We do not offer delivery.
lines.zh: : 您是要下外带订单吗？我们不提供外送。

lines.en: : I need your help. I am locked in my room and being forced to fill out magazine sweepstakes in order to escape.
lines.zh: : 我需要你的帮助。我被锁在自己的房间里，被迫靠填杂志抽奖才能逃出去。

lines.en: : Do you find joy in prank calling local businesses?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢恶作剧骚扰本地商家吗？

lines.en: : No, it's true. I need your help.
lines.zh: : 不，是真的。我需要你的帮助。

lines.en: : Who may I ask is calling?
lines.zh: : 请问您是哪位？

lines.en: : It's Sensei. Do you really not recognize my voice by now?
lines.zh: : 是 Sensei。你到现在真的听不出我的声音吗？

lines.en: : It was a test. You have passed.
lines.zh: : 那是个测试。你通过了。

lines.en: : Have you tried opening your door?
lines.zh: : 你试过开门吗？

lines.en: : No. I don't think that option unlocks until I've defeated all of the magazines.
lines.zh: : 没有。我觉得那个选项要等我打败所有杂志才会解锁。

lines.en: : This sounds like an unfortunate situation you've found yourself in. But I'm afraid that the only assistance I am able to provide is that of information.
lines.zh: : 听起来你处境不幸。但恐怕我唯一能提供的帮助只有情报。

lines.en: : Can't you come here and open the door?
lines.zh: : 你不能过来帮我把门打开吗？

lines.en: : No. I am unfortunately unable to leave Tojo Ramen at the moment.
lines.zh: : 不行。很遗憾我此刻无法离开 Tojo Ramen。

lines.en: : But if you need any cooking tips, I would be willing to share some with you.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你需要任何烹饪建议，我很乐意跟你分享一些。
: 其实……

lines.en: : If you were to prepare a dish like...chili-
lines.zh: : 如果你要做一道……比如辣豆酱——

lines.en: : My first tip is to never cook something without noodles.
lines.zh: : 我的第一条建议是：绝不要做任何没有面条的东西。

lines.en: : Thank you for your call and best of luck with your door.
lines.zh: : 感谢您的来电，祝您顺利搞定您的门。

lines.en: : No, wait. If you were going to make chili and had to use one unusual ingredient to really make it shine...
lines.zh: : 不，等等。如果你要做辣豆酱，还必须用一种不寻常的配料来让它出彩……
: 你会选什么？

lines.en: : Well, if making something else was not an option, I suppose I'd go with something along the lines of...
lines.zh: : 好吧，如果不能做别的，我想我会选类似于……
: 咖啡。
: 咖啡？

lines.en: : Reducing the coffee along with tomato paste, another key ingredient in chili, would impart a strong roasted flavor that would elevate the dish to the next level.
lines.zh: : 把咖啡和番茄膏——辣豆酱里另一味关键配料——一起收汁，会带来浓郁的烘焙风味，把这道菜提升一个层次。
: 我明白了……

lines.en: : This has been a cooking lesson with Tsuneyo Tojo, stand-up comedian chef.
lines.zh: : 以上是 Tsuneyo Tojo，单口喜剧厨师带来的烹饪小课堂。

lines.en: : Thank you for calling Tojo Ramen. Do you require anything else?
lines.zh: : 感谢致电 Tojo Ramen。您还需要什么吗？
: 不……我想就这样吧。

lines.en: : Thanks, Tsuneyo. I really appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Tsuneyo。真的很感激。

lines.en: : Please do not call here again unless you intend to order food. Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 除非您打算点餐，否则请勿再次致电。再见。
: Tsuneyo，我没有—

lines.en: : Then you are wasting my time.
lines.zh: : 那你就是在浪费我的时间。

lines.en: : Please do not call here again unless you intend to order food. Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 除非您打算点餐，否则请勿再次致电。再见。

lines.en: Tsuneyo hangs up the phone and I have no choice but to exit the phone booth- which makes me really sad since it was very warm inside.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 挂了电话，我别无选择，只能走出电话亭——这让我很难过，因为里面真的很暖和。
: 现在做什么？

lines.en: I need to consume food if I want to stay healthy.
lines.zh: 我需要摄入食物才能保持健康。

lines.en: The only problem is there are so many kinds!!!
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是种类太多了！！！

lines.en: Which kind of food do I want to eat today?
lines.zh: 今天我想吃哪种食物？
西瓜

lines.en: A melon materializes out of thin air in my hands and I decide to consume it because that is the choice I selected.
lines.zh: 一颗瓜凭空出现在我手里，我决定把它吃掉，因为这是我选的选项。
: 好吃！瓜！

lines.en: Maya would be so happy if she were me right now.
lines.zh: 如果 Maya 现在是我，她一定会很开心。
{i}你的甜瓜点数提升到了 [melonpoint]！{/i}
: 要继续吗？
巧克力

lines.en: I search around the room for a bar of chocolate and find one halfway under the bed.
lines.zh: 我在房间里四处找巧克力棒，在床底下找到了半块。

lines.en: There are a few bugs on it, but it's no problem once I dust them off.
lines.zh: 上面有几只虫子，不过我把它们掸掉就没问题了。

lines.en: I open my mouth and put the chocolate inside.
lines.zh: 我张开嘴，把巧克力放进去。
我就是这样吃东西的。
{i}你的巧克力点数提升到了 [chocolatepoint]！{/i}
: 要继续吗？
汉堡

lines.en: Since I am the Hamburger Man, I obviously decide to eat a hamburger.
lines.zh: 既然我是汉堡侠，我显然决定要吃个汉堡。

lines.en: Or at least I would if I had any...
lines.zh: 至少如果我有汉堡的话我会这么做……

lines.en: I stare down at my empty hands and come to terms with starving to death.
lines.zh: 我低头盯着自己空空的手，接受了自己要饿死的事实。

lines.en: {i}Due to a lack of hamburgers, your hamburger points do not increase!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}由于缺乏汉堡，你的汉堡点数不提升！{/i}
: 要继续吗？
白米饭

lines.en: White rice sounds delicious right now.
lines.zh: 现在白米饭听起来很美味。

lines.en: I should eat some of that.
lines.zh: 我应该吃点。

lines.en: I find a piece of a key inside my bowl of white rice!
lines.zh: 我在我的白米饭碗里找到了一块钥匙！

lines.en: I can use this to escape!
lines.zh: 我可以用它逃出去！

lines.en: : I think I'm done eating for now.
lines.zh: : 我想我吃够了。
: 我该改做什么？
{i}你的米饭点数提升到了 [ricepoint]！{/i}
: 要继续吗？
花生

lines.en: I decide to stuff myself with Chinami's favorite food.
lines.zh: 我决定把自己塞满 Chinami 最爱的食物。

lines.en: I eat so many peanuts that bumps begin to protrude from all parts of my body.
lines.zh: 我吃了太多花生，全身各处都鼓起了包。

lines.en: Once your stomach is full, it is okay to use the rest of the space inside of you to store nutrients.
lines.zh: 一旦你的胃被填满，你体内剩下的空间也可以用来储存营养。

lines.en: I am glad I decided to eat peanuts.
lines.zh: 我很高兴自己决定吃花生。
{i}你的花生点数提升到了 [peanutpoint]！{/i}
: 要继续吗？
蒜香面包

lines.en: I throw a small banquet for myself and partake in the body of Christ with a slight Italian twist.
lines.zh: 我为自己办了一场小型宴会，领受了基督的身体，只是带点意大利风味。

lines.en: I could eat this for the rest of eternity if I had to.
lines.zh: 如果非吃不可，我可以吃这个吃到天荒地老。

lines.en: Thankfully, my life is better than that and I have the option to consume it as a mere luxury.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，我的人生比那要好，我可以把它当成纯粹的奢侈品来享用。

lines.en: Thank you for your sacrifice, Jesus.
lines.zh: 感谢你的牺牲，耶稣。

lines.en: Thank you for the food, Father.
lines.zh: 感谢赐予食物，天父。
{i}你的面包点数提升到了 [breadpoint]！{/i}
: 要继续吗？
拉面

lines.en: I take a page out of Tsuneyo's book and cook some instant noodles using the heat coming off of my laptop charger.
lines.zh: 我照搬 Tsuneyo 的做法，用笔记本充电器散发的热量煮了包泡面。

lines.en: It takes a very long time, but both the microwave and hot plate are in the other room.
lines.zh: 要花很长时间，不过微波炉和电热板都在另一个房间。

lines.en: I would have brought them inside if I knew I was going to be locked in here.
lines.zh: 要是早知道自己会被锁在这儿，我就把它们拿进来了。
算了。
那就吃笔记本拉面吧！
{i}你的拉面点数提升到了 [ramenpoint]！{/i}
: 要继续吗？
活鱿鱼

lines.en: I approach a live squid that crawls out from under the bed and it reminds me of something I promised myself I'd forget.
lines.zh: 我走向一只从床底爬出来的活鱿鱼，它让我想起某件我发誓要忘掉的事。

lines.en: The way its eyes look when I lift it up and open my mouth burn a hole in my throat and ruin my appetite, but I am too far in to stop now.
lines.zh: 当我把它举起来、张开嘴时，它眼睛里的那种神色灼穿了我的喉咙，毁了我的胃口，但我已经陷得太深，停不下来了。

lines.en: I begin with the head. The texture is thick and hard to bite through effectively.
lines.zh: 我从头开始。它质地厚实，很难咬透。

lines.en: It doesn't help that it is still moving around either.
lines.zh: 它还一直在动，这一点也帮不上忙。

lines.en: A flood of different juices rush into my mouth and I don't want to think about what they are.
lines.zh: 一大股各种各样的汁液涌进我的嘴里，我不想细想它们都是什么。

lines.en: Soon enough, large chunks of the squid are gone.
lines.zh: 很快，鱿鱼的大块部分就没了。

lines.en: There is still some light left in its eyes.
lines.zh: 它的眼睛里还残留着一丝光。

lines.en: : I'm so sorry I have to do this to you.
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉，我不得不对你做这种事。
鱿鱼没有回答。
它为什么要回答呢？

lines.en: : It will all be over soon.
lines.zh: : 马上就结束了。
{i}你的鱿鱼点数提升到了 [squidpoint]！{/i}
: 要继续吗？
鸡肉三明治

lines.en: My recent meeting with a talking chicken has put me in the mood to eat a friend.
lines.zh: 最近跟一只会说话的鸡的相遇，让我有了吃掉一位朋友的兴致。

lines.en: Unfortunately, I lack both the companionship and the resources required to make this happen.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，我既缺少同伴，也缺少做成这事所需的资源。

lines.en: I hang my head in shame and accept that I will have to eat something else instead.
lines.zh: 我羞愧地低下头，接受了自己只能吃点别的的事实。
: 要继续吗？
奇亚籽

lines.en: I reach into a bag of chia seeds someone left on my desk and begin to shovel them into my mouth.
lines.zh: 我把手伸进有人留在桌上的一袋奇亚籽，开始往嘴里猛塞。

lines.en: It is mildly unpleasant at first, but the saliva inside of my mouth hydrates them and turns it into a better experience after a little bit of time.
lines.zh: 一开始有点难受，但我嘴里的唾液把它们湿润后，过一会儿体验就好多了。

lines.en: As such, I elect to keep the chia seeds in my mouth for at least one minute after each handful.
lines.zh: 因此，我决定每抓一把，就让奇亚籽在嘴里至少含上一分钟。

lines.en: The spit flavored mini food makes a wonderful afternoon snack that I can eat millions of without gaining any weight.
lines.zh: 这种唾液风味的小零食是绝妙的下午点心，我可以吃上几百万颗而不长胖。

lines.en: My stomach begins to ache, but I do not care.
lines.zh: 我的胃开始疼了，但我不在乎。
我必须吃更多种子。
{i}你的奇亚籽点数提升到了 [chiapoint]！{/i}
: 要继续吗？
章鱼烧

lines.en: Some hot, mutilated octopus balls would really hit the spot right now.
lines.zh: 现在来点热乎的、被大卸八块的章鱼球正合适。

lines.en: Thankfully, I keep a secret stash of them underneath my bed next to a shoebox full of spoons that I've been saving for a rainy day.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，我在床底下藏了一批，旁边还有一鞋盒的勺子，是我攒着以备不时之需的。

lines.en: I reach under the bed for the hidden takoyaki but get distracted when I cut my hand on something sharp.
lines.zh: 我伸手到床底下摸那些藏起来的章鱼烧，却被什么锋利的东西割伤了手，分了神。

lines.en: It's probably just one of the spoons.
lines.zh: 大概只是其中一把勺子。

lines.en: {i}Your takoyaki points don't rise because you give up before finding any!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}因为你还没找到就放弃了，你的章鱼烧点数没有提升！{/i}
: 要继续吗？
披萨

lines.en: : Time for a hot cheese wheel!
lines.zh: : 热芝士轮时间到了！

lines.en: I try to call the hot cheese wheel store and place an order for delivery, but my phone won't work for some reason.
